scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.lint:api: server/.venv/bin/ruff check server/app server/tests && server/.venv/bin/ruff format --check server/app server/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm --prefix web test
scripts.test:all: npm run lint:api && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
